tasks.label: start-infra
tasks.detail: Kafka stack + Postgres (Postgres is not in docker-compose-kafka.yml)
tasks.command: docker compose -f docker-compose-kafka.yml up -d && (docker start order-service-postgres 2>/dev/null || docker run -d --name order-service-postgres -e POSTGRES_DB=orderdb -e POSTGRES_USER=postgres -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=postgres -p 5432:5432 postgres:16)

tasks.label: stop-infra
tasks.command: docker compose -f docker-compose-kafka.yml down && docker rm -f order-service-postgres
